title: Handoff export
responsibility: Produce the frozen handoff package under docs/plan/ from planning-content, on an explicit deterministic command, such that a recipient can begin their part of the work without asking the planner for information the plan should already contain.
notes: ⚠️ HISTORY, 2026-08-22 (superseded the same day — see the end of this note). AS OF ITS CREATION it was PLANNED, NOT BUILT: This is the first component designed BEFORE it exists rather than recorded after; every other CMP describes a module already on disk. `implementedBy` is absent for exactly that reason, and its absence is the only signal in the artifact that says so. ⚠️ THE HAZARD THIS CREATES IS REAL AND IS RAISED AS QST-0015: the orphan check counts EDGES, so creating this record takes the orphan count to zero while REQ-0010 remains unimplemented. 'All requirements trace to a component' becomes true; 'the handoff exists' does not. A correct rule producing an invisible outcome is the pattern #94, #107 and #122 all describe, and the attestation carries the distinction until something better does. ⚠️ Design decided in DEC-0009: an explicit deterministic command (`npm run handoff`), NEVER a gate side effect. The gate stays read-only. ✅ CURRENT STATE, 2026-08-22: BUILT AND PUBLISHING. `implementedBy` points at the code and tests; ACC-0001..ACC-0009 all pass; the command published 23 files from the real project with a stable snapshot.
